sourceEvidence.family: 改善措置 vs 是正処置
sourceEvidence.assessment: Source explicitly calls 改善措置 改善措施. Patches affect HACCP response labels, not distinct 是正処置. Canonical food-2-013 paragraph p3 keeps cause-removal recurrence-prevention distinction and is not patched.

sourceEvidence.family: 管理基準 vs 許容限界
sourceEvidence.assessment: All13 replacements belong to SSW1 HACCP management-standard contexts, shared 管理基準 glossary or HACCP diagram. No SSW2 許容限界 or CL/OL distinction is replaced. Japanese food-1-025/026/027,q295,q359 directly say 管理基準.
Generic spore term becomes 芽胞/芽胞菌. 蜡样芽孢杆菌 remains exactly unchanged in all affected fields, as sourcepage38 separately displays species and spore terms.
虚惊事件 and 虚惊分析活动 directly match source labels; no injuries/near-miss conditions altered.
Hazard factors, clean-area labels, nonheated cooking, best-before label, filling, microbial checks and pointing/calling align with textbook terminology; no operational conditions changed.

nonBlockingNotes.note: Coordinated phrase retains 物理性 while changing 化学性危害 to 化学危害. It remains semantically correct; complete stylistic parallelism is outside this terminology-only acceptance decision.
